descriptionHtml: A touch of elegance in every detail. The Velantra Bag Scarf is crafted from soft, lightweight silk blend fabric and designed to drape effortlessly around your favorite Velantra bag. Whether tied on the handle, worn as a hair accessory, or styled around your neck, it adds a refined pop of color and personality to any look.

A nod to timeless equestrian elegance. The Velantra Horse Charm is handcrafted from smooth leather and finished with precision detailing, designed to clip effortlessly onto your favorite bag. Sophisticated yet playful, it adds a refined touch of personality and heritage-inspired charm to any look.

A miniature ode to the original. The Velantra Boat Tote Keychain captures the charm of the iconic tote in a collectible form. Crafted with premium materials and detailed stitching, it’s the perfect accessory for your keys, bag, or gift set—small in size, big on style.

Sophisticated yet functional, the Meridian is crafted from premium grained leather with a softly structured shape — designed to carry your day, laptop and planner and all, without sacrificing style.

Finished with polished hardware and reinforced handles, it holds its line from the 8 a.m. meeting to the dinner that follows. The balance of form and function for a woman always on the move.

• Dimensions: 11.4" Length x 5.5" Width x 7.1" Height (29cm x 14cm x 18cm)
  • Made from premium felt material
  • Removable dividers for customizable layout
  • Multiple pockets for organized storage
  • Lightweight and portable design
  • Compatible with Speedy, Neverfull, Bogg Bags & more
  • Available in multiple sizes and colors

The everyday workhorse. The Camille pairs sturdy canvas with leather trim in an open-top silhouette that goes everywhere and asks for nothing.

Canvas that takes a beating and leather that only gets better for it. A wide, open interior fits your laptop, water bottle, and the rest of the day's essentials, with reinforced handles built for a full load.

From the farmers market to the office to the boat — the one you reach for without thinking.

Black is a pre-order. It is all leather with no canvas, made to order in the first run, and expected to ship mid September 2026. Cognac, Army Green and Espresso are in stock and ship now.

A structured weekender built to hold three days and slide into the overhead bin. The Eleanor keeps its shape whether it's packed full or barely at all.

A smooth leather fold-over flap opens to a spacious, structured interior with room for a weekend's worth of everything. Reinforced handles and contrast stitching throughout, in one generous size.

Built for the Friday flight, the last-minute yes, and the trip you didn't overthink.

Pre-order. The Colette ships early October. Reserve yours now and your bag comes from the first production run.

Cashmere-feel brushed wool, belted in leather.

The fall tote that holds its shape. Soft brushed wool with real structure: a belted front, leather-wrapped handles, and aged gold hardware. It stands upright on its own, opens wide, and carries everything a full day asks of it, laptop included.

  • Cashmere-feel brushed wool body, softly structured
  • Leather-wrapped handles and belted front with gold eyelet detailing
  • Aged gold hardware, no logos
  • Open top, everything in reach
  • Fits a 13" laptop with room to spare

Dimensions: 19.7" W × 10.2" H × 7.1" D (50 × 26 × 18 cm) · Handle drop 6.3" (16 cm)

Black is a pre-order. It is all leather with no canvas, made to order in the first run, and expected to ship mid September 2026. Cognac, Army Green and Espresso are in stock and ship now.

A structured weekender built to hold three days and slide into the overhead bin. The Eleanor keeps its shape whether it's packed full or barely at all.

A smooth leather fold-over flap opens to a spacious, structured interior with room for a weekend's worth of everything. Reinforced handles and contrast stitching throughout, in one generous size.

Built for the Friday flight, the last-minute yes, and the trip you didn't overthink.

A structured top-handle bag, built so you never have to change bags before dinner.

A full-grain leather flap over tightly woven heavyweight canvas. A working gold turn-lock, two belted straps that cinch to a buckle on each side, and reinforced leather corners at every point that takes a knock. No logo anywhere, inside or out.

It carries a real wallet, your cards, a lip color and your keys, and the lock closes properly over all of it. The structured walls hold the shape full or nearly empty, so it stands up on its own instead of folding into a heap, and what you put in stays where you put it.

Inside, a full lining with a zipped pocket. Underneath, small metal feet, so the canvas never sits on the ground.

Light Chocolate, Dark Chocolate and Army Green. Made in limited runs.

The Vivienne is a pre-order. Every colorway is made to order in the first run, cut and finished after you order it. Expected to ship October. Nothing on this page ships from stock.

Vegetable-tanned leather all the way through, with a belted brass closure and a detachable shoulder strap. A large top handle bag that carries a real day.

One hide, one finish, on every panel. The corner caps, the gussets and the piping are the same leather as the body, and it darkens and softens the longer you carry it.
A suede body under a full leather collar, with rolled leather handles and leather at all four corners. Open at the top, 18.5 inches across, and soft on purpose.
